what: A sphere of radius 10 mm clipped at z = -6 and 7 has a lower rim of radius 8 mm. A coaxial cutter of radius r = 7.99999 mm extends from that rim to z = 0. At the 0.00001 mm coincidence tolerance, the kernel collapses the narrow annulus onto a shared rim. The sphere, top disc, bore wall and bore ceiling are the four faces of the open solid. A skin across the opening adds two faces while giving the same volume. Integrating the spherical sections and subtracting the cylinder gives pi * (100 * 13 - (7^3 - (-6)^3)/3 - 6*r^2) mm^3.
